title: Change control
description: Explain how a predictive project evaluates, approves and communicates changes to its agreed plan.

keyIdeas.label: what to analyse before a change
keyIdeas.text: On a predictive project, record proposed changes to the agreed scope and analyse their combined effects on schedule, cost, quality and risk before committing to them.

keyIdeas.label: who can approve a change
keyIdeas.text: Follow the agreed change process and decision authority before implementing a change to a controlled baseline; a request alone is not approval.

keyIdeas.label: what happens after a change is approved
keyIdeas.text: After a change is approved, update the affected baseline and working documents through the agreed process, communicate the decision and track implementation.

misconceptions: A small-sounding scope change cannot affect schedule or cost.
Any stakeholder request automatically authorises work.
A verbal approval means project records no longer need updating.
